title: Normalization of product mass
statement: Let $P$ be a product of $n$ finite probability spaces, with strictly positive coordinate weights summing to $1$, and let $m(x)$ be the product mass of an outcome $x$. Then the sum of $m(x)$ over all product outcomes is $1$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite product of n coordinate probability spaces
replaced: Let $P$ be a product of $n$ finite probability spaces with strictly positive atom masses and outcome space $\Omega=\prod_i\Omega_i$, with product masses $m(x)$. Then $\sum_xm(x)=1$.
